name: still-pomodoro
description: A calm Pomodoro timer with synthesized lo-fi music.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json --noEmit
scripts.start: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory dist
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:desktop && playwright test -c playwright.desktop.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
